messages:
Maya: handing off primary -> Raj. Active incident INC-2026-03-14-eu-embeddings-latency. Pager has calmed but p95 still elevated. Leaving context and follow-ups below.

IncidentBot: ALERT: embeddings latency p95 > 1.4s in eu-west-1 (18m). Affected routes: /embeddings/batch, /embeddings/stream. Incident ID INC-2026-03-14.

Maya: short timeline: saw spike around 07:18 CET, reduced batch size to 8, enabled KV cache fallback rule, and scaled dedicated pool +1 node (temporary). No user-facing errors reported, some retries observed. Runbook reference: /runbooks/embeddings-latency -> section 'scale-and-cache'.

Raj: ack — I'm primary for next 8h (09:00-17:00 CET). Dina will be secondary for overlap 12:00-20:00 CET. Coverage gap flagged: 17:00-20:00 CET we only have partial overlap. Can Kevin cover 18:00-20:00 CET? If not, Dina please see if you can extend.

Dina: I can stretch to 19:00 CET if needed. If Kevin picks up 18:00-20:00 CET that's ideal. Please add kv_cache_evictions_per_min to the runbook metrics so it's easier to triage next time.

Maya: filing follow-ups now — created tickets: TKT-4123 (increase embeddings cache TTL + test plan), TKT-4124 (investigate kernel selection mismatch on quantized path causing sporadic perf regressions). Assigned to Infra Team, due EOD +3. Ticket links: https://tickets.redwood/TKT-4123 and https://tickets.redwood/TKT-4124.

Raj: scheduling a short retro: Wed 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC (30m). Calendar invite will go to #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime. I'll draft a one-page RCA before the meeting — please drop logs/notes in that doc.

SRE Lead: quick ask — include per-route token counts and whether any Dedicated->Hosted fallback happened in TKT-4123. Also note any cost impact.

Maya: quick debug snippet I ran to collect cache and logs:
```
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=emb-serving --tail=200 | grep -i 'kvcache' -n
curl -s 'https://metrics/api/query?m=kv_cache_evictions_per_min&region=eu-west-1' | jq .
```
Outputs attached to TKT-4123.

Raj: running a canary against canary-2 instance now. If p95 < 0.6s for embeddings in the 10m window we'll remove the temporary +1 node scale. ETA ~30m.

IncidentBot: UPDATE: canary-2 latency p95 = 0.58s (10m window) — trending down.

Raj: good sign. Consolidated action items (assignments):
- Maya: finalize TKT-4123 (TTL change + test plan) — owner: Maya.
- Infra Team: TKT-4124 (kernel path / quantization mismatch) — owner: Infra Team.
- Raj: run canary validation + rollback plan (documented in ticket).
- Dina/Kevin: cover 17:00-20:00 CET gaps — confirm in calendar.
- SRE Lead: prepare per-route cost calc for retro.
Retro scheduled: Wed 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC. Related tickets: INC-2026-03-14, TKT-4123, TKT-4124.

Raj: ACK. I'll own the incident until handoff to next EU shift (~19:00 CET) or until it's closed.

Kevin: I can cover 18:00-20:00 CET. I've added myself to the on-call calendar and pinged Dina.

Maya: thanks team. Pinning a short handoff checklist here: 
- Current mitigations: batch_size=8, KV cache fallback enabled, +1 node on dedicated pool (temporary).
- Tickets filed: TKT-4123, TKT-4124.
- Retro: Wed 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC.
- Backup contacts: Raj (primary), Dina (secondary), Kevin (evening cover).

Raj: will follow up with a short post-handoff note once canary fully stable. Everyone please add anything missing to the tickets.

OpsBot: Note: automatic alert suppression enabled for INC-2026-03-14 while mitigations are active. Re-enable monitoring checks after 2h of stable p95 < 0.6s.

Maya: handing off complete — Raj, you have the floor. :ok_hand:
